scope: Offline iteration/column-quality diagnostic; no end-to-end time claim

protocol.purpose: Separate target-aware column quality from the loss caused by replacing a preconditioner during CG.
protocol.criterion: The established f/P-greedy criterion applied to A=K+lambda I: choose the remaining index maximizing the squared Schur right-hand-side residual divided by the Schur diagonal.
protocol.construction: Build exactly 32 partial Cholesky columns of A and update the forward-substitution residual. Build the ordinary kernel Nystrom preconditioner from the chosen actual K columns, then freeze it before PCG begins.
protocol.initial_guess: Run both zero and the coordinate Galerkin solution supported on selected indices; apply the identical initial-guess variants to RP and matrix-only greedy pivot controls.
protocol.strong_controls: Unpreconditioned CG and Gaussian power Nystrom with 2, 4, and 8 setup passes, all rank32. One solve recurrence and true residual tolerance across methods.
independent_checks: each pivot score equals the exact coordinate-Galerkin energy decrease on a small SPD problem
independent Cholesky solve for coordinate initial guess
protocol.decision: No selection-criterion weight, rank, or tolerance sweep after failure against strong fixed controls. Positive iteration evidence requires a later complete-cost test and a separate novelty assessment.
protocol.novelty_boundary: f/P-greedy is established target-dependent kernel approximation. This diagnostic tests transfer to fixed-budget preconditioning; it does not claim a new algorithm.
